svg.title: Taproot address construction
svg.desc: MuSig2 combines Alice's key K_A and Bob's key K_B into the internal key P. Backup script A, Alice alone after the deadline, and backup script B, Bob alone after a later deadline, are each hashed into a leaf hash, and the two leaf hashes are hashed together into the script tree root. A tagged hash of P and the script tree root gives the tweak t, and adding it gives the output key Q = P + tG. Bech32m then prepends witness version 1, regroups into 53 values of 5 bits, appends a 6-value checksum, and writes a 62-character address beginning with bc1p.

text.tspan: Bob alone after a later deadline
Tweak t = tagged hash (TapTweak) of P and the script tree root
Add the tweak to the internal key: Q = P + tG
Write bc1, then one character per value
